test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the value of

frac{sec 35circ}{cosec 55circ} - frac{cos 25circ}{sin 65circ}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the complementary angle properties: sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ and cos(90° − θ) = sin θ.

Therefore, sec 35° = cosec 55° and cos 25° = sin 65°.

The expression becomes: (cosec 55° / cosec 55°) − (sin 65° / sin 65°)

⇒ 1 − 1 = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(sec 35° / cosec 55°) − (cos 25° / sin 65°)

**Formula Used:**

sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ

cos(90° − θ) = sin θ

**Calculations:**

⇒ sec 35° = sec(90° − 55°) = cosec 55°

⇒ cos 25° = cos(90° − 65°) = sin 65°

Substituting these values into the given expression:

⇒ (cosec 55° / cosec 55°) − (sin 65° / sin 65°)

⇒ 1 − 1

⇒ 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Complementary Angles in Trigonometry

sin(90° − θ) = cos θ, tan(90° − θ) = cot θ, and sec(90° − θ) = cosec θ.

Basic Trigonometric Identities

sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, sec²θ − tan²θ = 1, and cosec²θ − cot²θ = 1.

Reciprocal Relations

sin θ = 1 / cosec θ, cos θ = 1 / sec θ, and tan θ = 1 / cot θ.
